lines.text: A brain scan finishes at an Alaska hospital. Every minute without blood flow, about two million brain cells die.
lines.t: A brain scan finishes at an Alaska hospital. Every minute without blood flow, about two million brain cells die.

lines.text: Before, just sending those images to Anchorage could take forty-five minutes.
lines.t: Before, just sending those images to Anchorage could take forty-five minutes.

lines.text: Now a volunteer group, the Alaska Stroke Coalition, has hospitals using A I software called RapidAI.
lines.t: Now a volunteer group, the Alaska Stroke Coalition, has hospitals using A I software called RapidAI.

lines.text: It looks for a large vessel occlusion, a clot blocking a big brain artery.
lines.t: It looks for a large vessel occlusion, a clot blocking a big brain artery.

lines.text: In one case, it alerted the doctor seconds after the scan.
lines.t: In one case, it alerted the doctor seconds after the scan.

lines.text: The results reached the local team and the clot specialists at once.
lines.t: The results reached the local team and the clot specialists at once.

lines.text: That speed counts. The whole state has five doctors who can pull out those clots.
lines.t: That speed counts. The whole state has five doctors who can pull out those clots.

lines.text: In another case, a man in his sixties fell and came into a hospital in Alaska's interior.
lines.t: In another case, a man in his sixties fell and came into a hospital in Alaska's interior.

lines.text: Less than half an hour after he arrived, his team called Providence in Anchorage for a transfer.
lines.t: Less than half an hour after he arrived, his team called Providence in Anchorage for a transfer.

lines.text: That call came two minutes before the official scan report.
lines.t: That call came two minutes before the official scan report.

lines.text: Four hours and twenty-three minutes after he arrived, the clot was out.
lines.t: Four hours and twenty-three minutes after he arrived, the clot was out.

lines.text: The information moves ahead of the patient. Early, unpublished data shows about a thirty percent faster start on clot removal once patients reach Anchorage.
lines.t: The information moves ahead of the patient. Early, unpublished data shows about a thirty percent faster start on clot removal once patients reach Anchorage.

lines.text: Now the hard part. Kelly Isaacs, who manages Providence's stroke program, says she can't really show statistically significant proof it's made a big difference.

lines.text: Alaska doesn't have consistent reporting of stroke outcomes. The software throws false positives.

lines.text: The clinicians answer that a doctor reviews every output, and that read decides the transfer.

lines.text: Six hospitals that got it free all say they want to keep it and pay for it.

lines.text: Over three point one million dollars in federal rural health money is set to build an A I imaging network across twenty-one hospitals, Utqiagvik to Juneau.
